answer: Burn-bond gating makes each candidate identity pay a nonrefundable proof-of-work bond of two GPU-hours and a slashable stake before earning credit. Admission passes a fixed-width inlet capped at four identities per block, and newcomers sit out a thirty-day cold-start tundra where rewards vest but cannot move. A five-hundred-key ring burns a thousand GPU-hours and waits months for entry; the fable that fresh keys are cheap dies against that bill, since coordination saves nothing when every node pays independently.
